name: seedicon-site
description: Marketing site + playground for the seedicon package. Never published to npm.

scripts.//prebuild: The site imports seedicon from the parent folder (file:..), so the package has to be built before Next.js compiles. Once seedicon is on npm you can drop this script and pin a published version in dependencies instead.
scripts.prebuild: cd .. && npm ci --no-audit --no-fund && npm run build
